name: asio
description: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming that provides developers with a consistent asynchronous model using a modern C++ approach.

io-uring.description: Linux io_uring backend. Adds the liburing dependency; the consumer still defines ASIO_HAS_IO_URING (kernel 5.10+ required) and links uring.

regex.description: Boost.Regex (optional) if you use any of the read_until() or async_read_until() overloads that take a boost::regex parameter.

spawn.description: Build with spawn (stackful coroutines) support, backed by Boost.Context

ssl.description: OpenSSL (optional) if you use Asio's SSL support.
